correctness.rationale: The Euclidean parametrization counts each unordered primitive positive triangle once and gives J=mn(m−n)(m+n)/6. In the odd-m branch, F(m,n)−F(m,n′) for even n,n′ is (n−n′) times a unit at 2; this bijects even inputs with even outputs at all levels. The swapped parity branch has the same count. At 3 every nonzero residue pair gives F≡0, and its gradient reduces to (−n³,m³), so exactly three of nine lifts hit each prescribed next digit. The local counts at moduli 2^{a+1} and 3^{b+1} give 16Q pairs per target mod 6Q for Q=2^a3^b, including Q=1. In the sector of area πX/8, Möbius inversion uses only d coprime to 6. For each d, the parameter classes for the rescaled variables are the inverse-scaled preimages of the target classes (F is degree four), preserving the number of classes rather than fixing each class. The absolutely convergent factor is 9/π² and the summed boundary errors are O_Q(√X log(2X)), yielding X/(2πQ). At p≥5 the same primitive lattice argument makes nonzero pairs equally weighted; four lines contribute 4(p−1) of p²−1 pairs. Hence uniformity modulo any multiple of p is impossible. Independent enumeration agreed on all fibers for 14 smooth moduli through Q=72 and on the zero counts for p=5,7,11,13,17,19.
residual_risks: The finite replay checks local counts only. The fixed-modulus hypotenuse asymptotic rests on the sector and coprimality argument, not numerical agreement.
The 16Q certificate is for Q=2^a3^b; it is not asserted for all Q.

evidence: Kontorovich–Oh analyze squarefree sieve levels and give g^{F_A}(p)=4/p+O(p^{−3/2}); in the proof four lines on the cone form the odd-prime zero locus.
Romik gives primitive-pair density and angular statistics; Liu counts primitive triangles under size cutoffs including area, not all residue classes of A/6.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The general primitive-pair counting tools provide the passage from local classes to sector asymptotics, but do not determine the pushforward of J. The prior squarefree sieve does not prescribe all 2- and 3-power target multiplicities.

evidence: Buckley derives forced divisibility by six. The known four simple zero lines mechanically give 4/(p+1) among primitive nonzero pairs modulo p, so the exact odd-prime obstruction alone adds little.

The positive result needs independent flatness at the primes dividing the normalizing denominator: permutation within each opposite-parity branch at 2, uniform lifts from the eight primitive pairs at 3, and their product.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Divisibility merely defines J, and four-line squarefree counting proves a negative criterion for odd primes. Neither gives uniform lifting into arbitrary specified normalized residues at 2 or 3. No inspected antecedent supplies that missing exact pushforward or implies the complete classification by parameter substitution.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The polynomial and normalized area sequence are not new. Ordering a multiset by area, finding its fixed-divisor obstruction or giving a thin-orbit sieve density is not the same as counting every residue among all primitive triangles ordered by hypotenuse.

4181519973aa gives local factors for k-free odd legs; 345a9b314e46 classifies Legendre-symbol patterns for a Pythagorean pencil. The identical assigned record was a self-match.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: Neither the sequence table nor the related exact local classifications tabulates these fiber counts or classifies which moduli give uniformity. The same-day Legendre-symbol result concerns signs of different coordinates, not normalized areas.

originality.rationale: The supported distinct result is exact flatness of the normalized area on all dyadic and ternary depths and the consequent classification of all uniform fixed moduli in the full primitive triangle family. The normalized area, its factorization and the odd-prime zero-locus obstruction have substantial antecedents and are not independent grounds for novelty.
residual_risks: Equivalent dyadic or ternary pushforwards might occur in unindexed local-density or congruous-number literature. The checks identify known parts but do not establish absolute historical priority.

value.rationale: Normalization by the compulsory area factor gives a natural statistic. The exact all-target local law distinguishes full equidistribution from mere support and explains why precisely the primes removed by normalization permit uniformity at every depth. It yields a complete modulus classification and fixed-modulus counts rather than a list of congruences at a few small levels.
residual_risks: No uniform-in-Q asymptotic or result about distinct area values is asserted.
